title: Epidemiology of Diverticulitis in Lung Transplant Recipients
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to assess incidence, treatment modalities and outcome of complicated and uncomplicated diverticulitis in highly immunosuppressed lung transplant recipients (LTRs) in order to establish improved treatment strategies in this high risk patient collective.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Lung transplant recipient
* Diverticulitis

Exclusion Criteria:

* none
study_population: We want to retrospectively analyse our prospective database of lung transplant recipients at our institution between 1992 and 2013 with diverticulitis episodes.
